band_scope.box_limited_sensitivity_band: per-query min/max over the reference member and its one-at-a-time displacements along every near-null direction and every sensitivity-declared coordinate to the computational-box ends (or the declared step), without DDO154 re-calibration; limited by the computational box, which is not an empirical bound; label BOX_LIMITED_SENSITIVITY_BAND_FROM_REFERENCE_MEMBER_NOT_A_REALIZABLE_CURVE_NOT_HEADLINE; conditional on DDO154 D=4.04 and i=66 (A13/A23)
band_scope.headline: per-member within-error counts over all 43 rows for the admitted representative members (PRIMARY alternative) and the frozen reference member; conditional on DDO154 D=4.04 and i=66 (A13/A23)
band_scope.pointwise_envelope: per-query min/max over the admitted representative members of an INNER_SAMPLE of the DDO154 admitted set; varies only the identified directions actually spanned by the sample; near-null directions, fixed shared coordinates and NGC3198 nuisances are held at their trial values; label POINTWISE_ENVELOPE_NOT_A_REALIZABLE_CURVE; conditional on DDO154 D=4.04 and i=66 (A13/A23)

headline_conditions.admissibility: A13 as corrected by A23 (ROOT_DECISIONS_NGC3198_CONSTRUCTION_2026-10-17_V004_ADDENDUM.md, open, cited by name): Fixing D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc is a counted assumption of the headline calibration, forced by the stage bindings (run mode at D ≠ 4.04 is BLOCKED). 4.04 Mpc is the registered route-B/catalogue distance; the region distance_summary central value is 4.0365 Mpc, with conditional 68% interval [3.981, 4.111] Mpc. For exact admitted sets, the D = 4.04 slice lies inside the projection of the 4-D admitted region. Every freeze member is an admitted point, and forward_ngc never receives the DDO154 distance. Every computed slice band therefore lies inside the exact projection envelope, and a member within error on the slice is a member within error of the projection. Nothing stronger is claimed. The frozen headline (min/median/max of the per-member counts plus the reference-member count) is not monotone under restriction, so the test is not claimed to be stricter. The computed INNER_SAMPLE estimates of two different runs are not ordered. A miss on NGC3198 is read as conditional on D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc and i_DDO154 = 66° until the D Jacobian column bounds that effect.
